claim_boundary: RoboTwin/SAPIEN has robot-action benchmark execution. Isaac Sim has one completed five-command task-semantic bundle using primitive proxies, scripted object-space actions, a backend-native trace, and a target verifier. This is not robot embodiment, joint-action policy, source-asset, material, or learned-policy transfer. Articraft remains a bounded catalog/probe source; the remaining rows are unexecuted targets.
